verdict.rationale: A dedicated rate-limits docs page exists (it points developers to AI Studio to view active limits), and the pricing pages say paid tiers get higher production rate limits. Community reports describe tier mechanics concretely, such as Tier 1 being capped at about 250 requests/day and higher tiers needing $250+ in spend and a payment more than 30 days old, which corroborates a tiered scheme. The pack, however, shows no documented RPM/TPM figures or 429 error details, and community posts describe tier progression as friction rather than clearly documented. Missing for 10: documented requests- and tokens-per-minute values per model and tier, a documented explanation of how tiers scale and qualify, and documentation of the 429 response format and retry guidance.
